dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。本日は、お越しくださって、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: イライラする
dialogue.content: I'm feeling irritated.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね…
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: マジでもう嫌になるくらいです
dialogue.content: Seriously, it's getting to the point where I'm just sick of it.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 嫌になるほどイライラしてしまうのですね…どんなことでイライラされているのか、
dialogue.content: So you're feeling so irritated that you're sick of it... What is it that's making you feel so irritated,

dialogue.origin: 少しずつでもかまいませんので、どうぞ、お話しくださいね
dialogue.content: Even a little at a time is fine, so please feel free to tell me about it.

dialogue.origin: 彼氏
dialogue.content: My boyfriend.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 彼さんの事なんですね。彼さんの、どんなことにイライラされているのでしょう？
dialogue.content: So it's about your boyfriend. What about him is making you feel irritated?

dialogue.origin: 話し合いがまともにできない
dialogue.content: We can't have a proper conversation.

dialogue.origin: ええ、うまく話せないのは、確かに、イライラしますよね…
dialogue.content: Yes, not being able to talk things through properly can certainly be frustrating…

dialogue.origin: どんな風に、まともに話し合いができないのでしょう？例えば、どんなことがありましたか？
dialogue.content: In what way is it hard to have a proper discussion? For example, what has happened?

dialogue.origin: 昨日、話してたら寝やがった
dialogue.content: Yesterday, while I was talking, he just fell asleep.

dialogue.origin: ええ！あなたが話しているのに…ですか？！ひどいですよね…
dialogue.content: Oh! While you were talking to him...?! That's terrible...

dialogue.origin: ほんとそれ
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: しかも自分の将来についてだったのに
dialogue.content: And it was about my own future, too.

dialogue.origin: どうでもいいんかよって気持ち
dialogue.content: It made me feel like he doesn't care at all.

dialogue.origin: そんな大事なお話なのに…がっかりしてしまいますよね…
dialogue.content: Even though it was such an important conversation... That must have been so disappointing.

dialogue.origin: マジでありえん
dialogue.content: Seriously, it's unbelievable.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ。あなたが頭にくるのも、無理もありませんよね…
dialogue.content: Yes, yes. It's no wonder you're so angry...

dialogue.origin: もっと真剣に聞いてほしいっておもいますよね・・・。
dialogue.content: You just want him to listen more seriously, don't you...

dialogue.origin: 寝るのは意味わからん
dialogue.content: Falling asleep just doesn't make any sense.

dialogue.origin: そう思ってしまいますよね…。
dialogue.content: I can understand why you'd feel that way...

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 聞いてもらえないのは、悔しいですよね‥。
dialogue.content: It must be frustrating not to be heard.

dialogue.origin: お話、詳しく伺っていきたいと思います。今日はどんなことでもかまいませんので、お気持ち、聞かせてくださいね。ところで、
dialogue.content: I'd like to hear more about it in detail. Please feel free to tell me anything that's on your mind today. By the way,

dialogue.origin: もしよろしければ、あなたのご年齢と、今日なんとお呼びしたらいいか、教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: If it's alright, could you tell me your age and how you'd like me to address you today?

dialogue.origin: みさ、20
dialogue.content: Misa, 20.

dialogue.origin: みささんですね。教えてくださって、ありがとうございます。彼さんとは、どのくらいお付き合いされているのでしょう？
dialogue.content: Misa, is that right? Thank you for telling me. How long have you been dating your boyfriend?

dialogue.origin: 一年半くらい
dialogue.content: About a year and a half.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。お二人は、お仕事とか、されているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Are you both working, or what are you each doing?

dialogue.origin: あっちは社会人こっちは専門
dialogue.content: He's working; I'm in a vocational school.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。彼さんのことについて、少しお話聞かせてくださいね。
dialogue.content: I see. Please tell me a little bit about your boyfriend.

dialogue.origin: 彼さんは、どんな方なんですか？
dialogue.content: What kind of person is he?

dialogue.origin: どんな？
dialogue.content: What do you mean?

dialogue.origin: みささんが、素敵だな、と思っているところとか、気になっている事でもいいし、話やすいとことからで構いませんよ。
dialogue.content: It could be something you think is wonderful about him, or something that's been bothering you. It's fine to start wherever is easiest for you to talk about.

dialogue.origin: 普通
dialogue.content: Normal.

dialogue.origin: 私のことどうでもいいんかな、、って思う
dialogue.content: I wonder if he doesn't care about me...

dialogue.origin: ええ。普通だって、思うんだね。例えば、普通って、性格が、普通にやさしい、とか、そういう感じかな？
dialogue.content: I see, so you think of him as ordinary. For example, when you say ordinary, do you mean his personality... like he's kind in a normal way, or something like that?

dialogue.origin: 入れ違って、ごめんなさい。
dialogue.content: Sorry, our messages crossed.

dialogue.origin: 自分中心
dialogue.content: He's self-centered.

dialogue.origin: そっか・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 表現するの下手
dialogue.content: He's not good at expressing himself.

dialogue.origin: うまく話が伝わらないと思うのかな？みささんにとっては、歯痒くなってしまうのかもしれないね…
dialogue.content: Do you feel like you can't get your point across to him? That must be very frustrating for you, Misa...

dialogue.origin: 伝わってんのかわかんない
dialogue.content: I don't know if it's getting through.

dialogue.origin: 興味ないんかな、あたしのこととか
dialogue.content: Maybe he's just not interested in me or anything.

dialogue.origin: そっか…表現するのが苦手で、うまく話が、彼さんに伝わらないことで、かなしい気持ちになってしまうんだね‥。
dialogue.content: I see... so because he has trouble expressing himself and you feel you can't get through to him, it makes you feel sad...

dialogue.origin: 表現が下手なのはあっち
dialogue.content: He's the one who's bad at expressing himself.

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさいね。みささんに、彼さんの気持ちが伝わらないことで。困っているのですね
dialogue.content: I'm sorry. So you're having trouble because his feelings aren't getting through to you. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: こっちはちゃんと考えて喋ったつもり
dialogue.content: I feel like I thought carefully about what I was saying.

dialogue.origin: なのに伝わってんのかわからん
dialogue.content: But I don't know if it's getting through.

dialogue.origin: もっと、上手に、言葉で伝えてほしいって、思っているっていうこと・・。そんな歯痒い気持ちなんだね。
dialogue.content: So you're wishing he would communicate his feelings to you more skillfully, with words... That's a very frustrating feeling.

dialogue.origin: 多分あいつには無理
dialogue.content: He probably can't do it.

dialogue.origin: うん、うん。そう思ってしまうんだね。でも、みささんはしっかり話したいことを伝えているのに、分かってもらえないのは、つらいよね…。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, yes. I see why you'd feel that way. But it must be hard for you, Misa, when you're communicating what you want to say so clearly, but you don't feel understood...

dialogue.origin: しんどい
dialogue.content: It's exhausting.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ。いつ頃から、こんな気持ちに悩んでいたのかな？
dialogue.content: I understand. Since when have you been struggling with these feelings?

dialogue.origin: ここ一ヶ月とか
dialogue.content: For about the last month or so.

dialogue.origin: なんかあっちの仕事が忙しいらしい
dialogue.content: Apparently, his work has been busy.

dialogue.origin: ええ。そうなんですねそうだったんだね、1カ月も…しんどかったね…
dialogue.content: I see. So it's been like that for a month... that must have been very tough for you...

dialogue.origin: 彼さんとは、どんな頻度で会っているのかな？
dialogue.content: How often do you and your boyfriend see each other?

dialogue.origin: 月一
dialogue.content: Once a month.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。月1　に会えた時にこそ、大切な話を聞いてほしいって思うよね…
dialogue.content: I see. When you only get to meet once a month, you'd especially want him to listen to you when you have something important to say...

dialogue.origin: 昨日は電話だけどね
dialogue.content: Yesterday was on the phone, though.

dialogue.origin: そっか、電話では、わりとお話しできているのかな？
dialogue.content: I see, do you generally talk fairly well on the phone?

dialogue.origin: 週一とか
dialogue.content: Like once a week.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ。せっかく、大切なお話をしているのに、電話の途中で、寝てしまうなんて…
dialogue.content: I see. And to think that even though you were having such an important conversation, he fell asleep in the middle of the call...

dialogue.origin: もうどうでも良くなるわ
dialogue.content: It just makes me feel like what's the point.

dialogue.origin: あなたは、一所懸命お話を伝えているのにね…。私は、あなたがもっと楽になれるように、一緒に考えていきたいと思っています。
dialogue.content: Even though you're trying so hard to communicate with him... I want to think with you about how you can feel more at ease.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: どうぞ、ゆっくり、お話、聞かせてくださいね。
dialogue.content: Please, take your time and tell me more.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 因みに、彼さんが聞いてくれないと思うのは、いつごろから感じているのかな？
dialogue.content: By the way, since when have you been feeling that your boyfriend doesn't listen to you?

dialogue.origin: 一ヶ月くらい前から
dialogue.content: Since about a month ago.

dialogue.origin: そっか、もしかして、それは、彼さんのお仕事が忙しくなったころから感じているのかな？
dialogue.content: I see, could it be that you started feeling this way around the time his work got busy?

dialogue.origin: そう
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そっか。お仕事が忙しいことで、疲れていたりするのかもしれないね。2人のお話しする時間をつくるのも、大変そうだと思うんだけど、
dialogue.content: I see. He might be tired from his work being so busy. I imagine it must be difficult to make time to talk,

dialogue.origin: みささんは、今のペースでお話しできている事には、何とか受け入れられている気持ちかな？
dialogue.content: Are you feeling you can somehow accept the current pace of communication?

dialogue.origin: まぁ仕方ないかな
dialogue.content: Well, I guess it can't be helped.

dialogue.origin: 彼さんの立場も、理解しようとされているんだね。だからこそ、できるときに、おお話をきちんとしたいと思いますよね。因みに、
dialogue.content: You're trying to understand his situation, too. That's why, when you do get a chance to talk, you want to have a proper conversation. By the way,

dialogue.origin: 彼さんに将来の事とか、一緒に話してほしかったんだよね。将来のこと、どんなことを伝えたかったのかな。
dialogue.content: You wanted to talk together about the future, right? What was it about the future that you wanted to share with him?

dialogue.origin: 自分のしたいこととか
dialogue.content: Things like what I want to do.

dialogue.origin: よくわかんなかったけど、
dialogue.content: I wasn't really sure about it, but,

dialogue.origin: うん、うん。ゆっくりでいいよ。みささんのしたいこと？
dialogue.content: Mm-hm, take your time. The things you want to do?

dialogue.origin: そう
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: それが見つかって
dialogue.content: I found it.

dialogue.origin: うん、うん！
dialogue.content: Mm-hm!

dialogue.origin: それについてがんばりたいなっていう
dialogue.content: and that I want to work hard on it.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ことを話してた
dialogue.content: That's what I was talking about.

dialogue.origin: そっか・・・。みささんにとって、うれしい事でもあり、頑張りたいことでもあること、一緒に喜んだり、相談に乗ってもらったりしてほしかったよね…
dialogue.content: I see… It's something that makes you happy and something you want to work on—you wanted him to celebrate with you and be there to talk it through…

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: そっか・・・。もっと聞いてほしかったね‥。そのことは、始めて伝えたことだったのかな？
dialogue.content: I see... You really wanted him to listen more... Was that the first time you told him about it?

dialogue.origin: 悩んでた時から少し話してたりした
dialogue.content: I'd talked about it a little since I was struggling with it.

dialogue.origin: (わかりにくかったですね)初めて”　でしたでしょうか？
dialogue.content: (That was unclear, my apologies) Was it the *first time*?

dialogue.origin: でも、こうしたいってちゃんと喋ったのが昨日
dialogue.content: But yesterday was the first time I clearly said, 'This is what I want to do.'

dialogue.origin: そうだったんだね、前から話していたことだったのに、もっと聞いてほしかったよね。　それから、みささんも昨日は、きちんたんだね。
dialogue.content: I see, so even though you'd talked about it before, you wanted him to listen more closely. And yesterday, Misa, you were very clear.

dialogue.origin: キチンと伝えたんだね。
dialogue.content: You communicated it clearly.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 今までのみささんのお話、少し整理させていただきますね。
dialogue.content: Let me try to summarize what you've told me so far, Misa.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: みささんなりに、なかなか会えない中にも工夫して、彼さんとお話しできる時間を大切にされていると思いました。でも、
dialogue.content: It seems to me that even though you can't meet often, you're making an effort in your own way and cherishing the time you have to talk with your boyfriend. But,

dialogue.origin: 昨日は、本当はもっと、具体的にお話を聞いてほしかったですよね…。
dialogue.content: yesterday, you really wanted him to listen more closely to the specifics…

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: みささんが楽になれるためには、どうんな風になったら、楽になれると思えるでしょうか？私は、彼さんが今、しっかり相手のお話を聞けそうな状態の時を把握してみることから始めてみることもいいかな、って思ったんだけど、
dialogue.content: What do you think would help you feel more at ease? One idea is to start by identifying times when he seems able to really listen.

dialogue.origin: それがわかると、彼さんの目や耳が大きく開いていて、しっかり、受け止めてもらえると思うんだけど、
dialogue.content: If you can recognize those times, his eyes and ears may be more open and he might really take things in.

dialogue.origin: みささんは、どんなふうになったらうまくいくと思えそうかな？
dialogue.content: What do you think would help things go better?

dialogue.origin: そもそも、私の話なんてどうでもいいんかなって思う
dialogue.content: I wonder if he doesn't care about what I have to say in the first place.

dialogue.origin: そう思ってしまうんだね・・。
dialogue.content: That's how it ends up feeling…

dialogue.origin: みささんは、
dialogue.content: Misa,

dialogue.origin: これからの彼さんとのおつきあいを、どんな風にしたいと思いますか？
dialogue.content: How would you like your relationship with him to be going forward?

dialogue.origin: 結婚とかしたいなって思ってたけど
dialogue.content: I had been thinking I'd like to marry him,

dialogue.origin: なんか、どうでも良くなってきた
dialogue.content: but I'm starting to feel like I don't care anymore.

dialogue.origin: そっか…。もしかして
dialogue.content: I see… Perhaps

dialogue.origin: 彼さんの気持ちと、みささんの気持ちの大きさの違いみたいなのが、気になってしまったのでしょうか…？
dialogue.content: you've started to notice something like a difference in the depth of his feelings and yours...?

dialogue.origin: そうかも
dialogue.content: Maybe so.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね…
dialogue.content: I understand…

dialogue.origin: あっちが自分のことどうでもいいって思ってるなら
dialogue.content: If he thinks I don't matter to him,

dialogue.origin: もうどうでもいいやって感じ
dialogue.content: then I feel like I don't care either.

dialogue.origin: そう思ってしまうような、言葉とかも、あったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Were there any words or anything that made you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 将来の話してる時の相槌が適当だった
dialogue.content: His responses while I was talking about the future were half-hearted.

dialogue.origin: 眠かったのか知らんけど
dialogue.content: I don't know if he was sleepy or what, but...

dialogue.origin: 言葉でどうでもいいとか言われたことはない
dialogue.content: He's never said in words that he doesn't care.

dialogue.origin: 相槌がそっけないと感じてしまって、そう思ったのですね…
dialogue.content: So you felt his responses were indifferent, and that's what made you think that...

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: もしも、
dialogue.content: If...

dialogue.origin: 彼さんの相槌がしっかりと受け止められたなら、みささんは今、
dialogue.content: if his responses had felt solid and validating, do you think you would now,

dialogue.origin: 彼さんとのことを考え直したりする気持にもなったりするのでしょうか・・・？
dialogue.content: feel more inclined to reconsider things with him?

dialogue.origin: どのように思われますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 別れるとかはやだな
dialogue.content: I don't want to break up or anything.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そう思うんだね。
dialogue.content: I see—that's how you feel.

dialogue.origin: では、どんな付き合い方ならできそうなのかな？
dialogue.content: Then, what kind of relationship do you think you could have?

dialogue.origin: もうよくわからないかも
dialogue.content: I don't really know anymore.

dialogue.origin: そっか…そう簡単には、気持ちは、測れないよね…
dialogue.content: I see... It's not so easy to figure out your feelings, is it...

dialogue.origin: 今回のことがショックすぎた
dialogue.content: This whole thing was just too much of a shock.

dialogue.origin: うん、うん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 昨日のことだもんね…
dialogue.content: It just happened yesterday, after all...

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: もしかしたら、少し、時間をかけて、冷静になってみて、考えてみるのもいいかもしれないね
dialogue.content: It might help to take some time, calm down a bit, and think things over.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: もちろん、これからのお付き合いをどうするのかは、あなたが決めていいこと。だと思うんですね。
dialogue.content: Of course, what you do about your relationship from here on is something you get to decide. I believe that.

dialogue.origin: あんまり別れたくはないですけど
dialogue.content: I don't really want to break up, though.

dialogue.origin: ええ　(どうぞ続けてくださいね)
dialogue.content: I see. (Please continue.)

dialogue.origin: あ、終わりです
dialogue.content: Oh, that's it.

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Alright. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 彼さんのこと、普通”　　っておっしゃっていたことについても、どんなところが好きなのかも、ゆっくり向き合ってみるのもいいかもしれないし、
dialogue.content: It might also help to take your time reflecting on what you like about him, even though you described him as 'ordinary,'

dialogue.origin: そうして、また悩んだりした時は、ここで一緒に、できそうなことを考えることもできますよ。
dialogue.content: and if you find yourself struggling again, we can think together here about possible next steps.

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんなどうでもいいことで、すみません
dialogue.content: I'm sorry for bringing up something so trivial.

dialogue.origin: とても大切なお話てすよ。気持ち、話してくれてありがとう。いつでもみささんのことを、応援していますね。
dialogue.content: This is a very important matter. Thank you for sharing your feelings. I'm always rooting for you, Misa.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今日は、時間になってしまったけど、良かったら、またいらしてみてくださいね。
dialogue.content: We're out of time for today, but if you'd like, please feel free to come again.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: では、今日のご相談は、おしまいでもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Then, shall we conclude today's session?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: はい。お越しくださって、ありがとうございました。終了させていただきますね。
dialogue.content: Alright. Thank you for coming in. We'll end the session now.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: みつけたやりたいことも、うまくいくといいね。失礼いたします。
dialogue.content: I hope the thing you found that you want to do goes well. Take care.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: (遅くなってしまい申し訳ありません)ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry for the delay.) Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ロープレ終了で、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Shall we conclude the role-play here?

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、こちらこそありがとうございました！大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: No, no, thank you very much as well! That's fine.

dialogue.origin: 大変勉強になりました。それでは、失礼いたします。ボタンを押しますね。
dialogue.content: This was a great learning experience. Well then, goodbye. I'll press the button now.

topic.sub: 彼氏とのコミュニケーション不足
